content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: elevated tail latency and streaming stalls detected for router/load-balancer in us-west-2. p95=850ms (SLO 600ms), p99=2300ms (SLO 1000ms). Endpoint cluster=/v1/generate, traffic spike at 2026-03-15T13:42:01Z. Possible routing anomalies observed (hot shard + misroutes). Alert: ALERT-ROUTER-TAIL-1769004821. Link: https://alerts.redwood/alerts/1769004821

oncall-elena: on it. seeing p99 ~2.3s on dashboard, streaming stalls where the client sees no tokens for ~2-3s then a burst. tagging @eng-router-tom @eng-sre-mike.

eng-router-tom: looking at router logs now. I see a recent policy rollout (commit d4f2b7) that adjusted shard affinity weights + enabled eager-fallback. Changes applied 3h ago. There are repeated reassigns for a small set of hot keys => hot partitioning + upstream handoffs.

eng-sre-mike: telemetry: loadsplit heatmap shows one shard at 6x typical qps in us-west-2, and connection churn to backends increased at 13:40Z. Also saw 502s spike but client retries suppress errors; still increases tail latency.

infra-ajay: I deployed a routing weight tweak at 10:30Z yesterday to prefer-local=true for a subset of routes (internal rollout). Could be interacting with hotspot traffic from a partner. Reverting is low-risk.

cs-zoe: customers reporting interactive app lagging (session timeouts at 8s). Two enterprise customers opened support tickets in the last 10m complaining about streaming stalls. Marking P1 for CS.

oncall-elena: immediate mitigation idea: disable sticky-affinity + rollback eager-fallback portion of rollout for us-west-2, and force a uniform round-robin for 10 minutes. Will coordinate with infra.

eng-router-tom: agreed. preparing command to set routing override for us-west-2. Doing canary on a small shard first.

deploy-bot: deploy d4f2b7 (routing-change) rolled out to 10% at 2026-03-15T10:32:10Z, 100% at 2026-03-15T11:05:02Z.

eng-sre-mike: attaching short trace snippet and logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T13:41:58Z] router-23 assign shard=hot-42 -> backend=pool-5 latency=120ms
[2026-03-15T13:42:03Z] router-23 handoff shard=hot-42 -> backend=pool-9 retry=1 total_ms=2320
[2026-03-15T13:42:09Z] backend-pool-9 stall token_stream no_response 2100ms
```

eng-router-tom: running override now:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  "https://control.redwood/api/v1/routing/override" \
  -d '{"scope":"us-west-2","policy":"round_robin","disable_sticky":true,"ttl_s":600}'
```

infra-ajay: applied override, propagation ~30s. Also increasing backend eviction threshold to avoid repeated handoffs.

oncall-elena: monitoring...

(2m) eng-sre-mike: post-override metrics -> p95=420ms, p99=920ms. Streaming stalls rate down ~78%. Customer-timeout events decreased. :thumbsup:

cs-zoe: telling impacted customers we've applied mitigation and are monitoring, offering to reopen sessions if issues persist.

eng-router-tom: follow-up tasks: 1) root cause triage on why sticky-affinity concentrated keys (likely client shard-key change), 2) add anti-hotkey eviction policy to router, 3) backfill improved tracing for fallback paths.

oncall-elena: is there any residual risk of oscillation if we leave override on?

eng-sre-mike: low for next 30m but we should plan a gradual rollback of override after traffic cools and verify heatmap. I'll instrument an automatic rollback if p99 stays <1s for 20m.

infra-ajay: noted. scheduling a controlled rollback window starting in 35m.

oncall-elena: handing off to night oncall @eng-sre-mike at 14:05Z with notes above. Will update incident doc and create postmortem template.

eng-sre-mike: acknowledged. saving timeline and links: dashboard https://dash.redwood/rt/1769004821 traces https://traces.redwood/1769004821.

cs-zoe: thanks team. I'll follow up with impacted customers with status updates and an ETA for longer-term fix.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated (manual override applied). Severity: P1 -> reduced. Will keep incident open for RCA. :white_check_mark:
